wavify.midnightconfig.title: Wavify Config
wavify.midnightconfig.reloadReminder: You may need to reload your chunks for changes to take affect!
wavify.midnightconfig.chunkRadius.toolti: The chunk radius of chunks that should spawn waves. Reduce this number if your struggling for performance!
wavify.midnightconfig.chunkUpdatesRescan: The amount of block updates that should happen in a chunk before it is rescanned for wave spawning.
wavify.midnightconfig.enableOceanWaves.t: Master toggle for ocean and beach (shoreline) waves. Turn off if you only want river waves, or no waves at all.
wavify.midnightconfig.enableRiverWaves.t: Master toggle for river waves. Turn off if you don't want waves on rivers.
wavify.midnightconfig.riverWaveSpawnRadi: Radius (in blocks) around you within which river waves spawn. Larger = waves appear further away; smaller = only close by.
wavify.midnightconfig.riverWaveDensity.t: Roughly how many river waves appear per 100 river water blocks near you.
wavify.midnightconfig.riverWaveTravelBlo: How far (in blocks) a river wave travels down the channel before fading out.
wavify.midnightconfig.waveYOffset.toolti: Shifts the whole wave (body and foam) up or down. Applied in both vanilla and shader modes. Negative = lower.
wavify.midnightconfig.shaderWaveYSink.to: Only applied when an Iris/Oculus shaderpack is active. Sinks the wave body below water so the shaderpack's water reflections render on top. More negative = waves sit deeper. 0 disables shader compensation.
wavify.midnightconfig.enableWaveSounds.t: Plays a looping ambient ocean sound when ocean waves are nearby, and a river sound when river waves are nearby. Sounds fade in/out smoothly.
wavify.midnightconfig.waveSoundVolume.to: Master volume multiplier for the ocean and river ambient loops.
wavify.midnightconfig.enableWetOverlay.t: Darkens the ground where a wave washes up, as if the sand got wet. Turn off to disable the effect entirely.
wavify.midnightconfig.spawnDistance.tool: How far out from the shore waves spawn, in blocks.
wavify.midnightconfig.transparency.toolt: Opacity of the wave body. 1.0 is fully solid.
wavify.midnightconfig.applyTransparencyT: When on, the white foam fades with the wave body instead of staying opaque.
wavify.midnightconfig.colorSource.toolti: Where wave color comes from. Biome uses the water color of the biome; Custom uses the color below.
wavify.midnightconfig.customColor.toolti: Wave color used when Color Source is set to Custom.
wavify.midnightconfig.biomeColorOverride: Per-biome color overrides, comma separated, e.g. minecraft:river=3f76e4. These win over both Biome and Custom.
